## Unimplemented assertions (12)

| ID | Specification reference |
|---|---|
| MM-028 | VAD tree in the kernel: a process address space is described by a VAD tree whose regions carry protection, kind, and backing |
| MM-029 | Page tables in the kernel: per-process address spaces are built over frames from the allocator |
| MM-030 | Higher-half kernel mapping: the kernel is linked in the top 2 GiB and the identity map is dropped |
| MM-031 | Kernel heap in the kernel: a `GlobalAlloc` over regions taken from the frame allocator, with the size-class bins from nolx-mm-core |
| MM-032 | Demand paging and copy-on-write: the four fault causes resolve against the VAD tree and the commit charge |
| MM-033 | Pool accounting in the kernel: the pools are charged from the boot log and reported through the object manager |
| MM-034 | NUMA node list: one buddy allocator per node and a zonelist that prefers the local node |
| UN-001 | XSH unlink: an entry is removed but an open file remains accessible until the last descriptor closes |
| UN-002 | XSH link: creating a hard link to a directory fails with EPERM unless privileged |
| UN-003 | XSH rename: renaming a directory onto one of its own descendants fails with EINVAL |
| UN-004 | XSH rmdir: removing a non-empty directory fails with ENOTEMPTY |
| UN-005 | XSH mkdir: creating an existing path fails with EEXIST |
